title: Baby fix
description: A resource pack that changes the appearance of baby mobs, making them look cleaner and more consistent with the overall Minecraft style while staying close to vanilla.
body: This resource pack is designed to improve the appearance of certain baby mobs from the recent “Tiny Takeover” drop. It fixes some of the less polished designs, making baby villagers, zombie villagers, animals, and other small mobs look cleaner and more visually consistent while keeping the charm of vanilla Minecraft intact
